geist-mono.$description:
Typeface Geist Mono (code). Global scale; parts use a Tier 2 type token.

How Chip uses its two fonts: Lexend reads: every sentence and label (body, helper, buttons, nav, tabs, fields, tags, pills, table cells, captions, card and section titles); 400 text, 500 labels/nav/tabs, 600 card titles, selected and emphasis; 16px+, line height 1.5. Geist Mono is the brand and the figures: page titles with the red dot, lane names, numbered pins, standalone figures (stat values, 42/44, count pills), code, keys, the Brief label; 600; tighter tracking only at 32px+. A number inside a sentence stays Lexend; a number that stands alone is Geist Mono. Never Geist Mono for a sentence; never a third face. (Elleta, 18 Nov: “lets make sure we have guidelines for how we use the new font and geist”)
